what_happened.line: The Finance Committee reviewed a question checklist for large capital projects, chiefly the conversion of the TC Passios building to town offices, ahead of a May town meeting.
No cost estimate for the Passios project exists yet; an earlier placeholder range was recalled.
The committee discussed documenting revolving and special revenue funds, and heard town manager and finance director reports on insurance, grants and capital projects.
The only vote approved three sets of prior minutes.
Members agreed to expect meeting materials 48 hours ahead, and set the next meeting for the five-year forecast and capital plan.

why_it_matters: The Passios conversion could add debt or operating costs that residents may be asked to approve at a May town meeting, and whether it is paid through a debt exclusion or the operating budget affects tax bills.
The committee's checklist and its push to document revolving funds set what information the town must supply before it asks for money.
